risks.risk: Wrong gearbox ratio/spec (ratio i, shaft size, mounting pattern) leading to incompatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label showing ratio i, model/serial, and input/output specs (or stamped markings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used speed reducer with unknown ratio/spec (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Internal bearing/gear wear or damage not visible externally; may fail under load.
risks.proof: Short video of it running (bench run) and a sound clip to support 'no knock'.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven for smooth operation (worst-case: may have issues).

risks.risk: Oil/seal problems (leaks, wrong oil, contamination) not confirmable from photo 0.
risks.proof: Photos of oil fill/drain area and seals/mating faces; show oil condition if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing service (worst-case: may leak).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incorrect mounting hardware/flange/coupling.
risks.proof: Photos of both input and output ends showing shaft/flange details and what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst-case: buyer may need extra parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the nameplate/label (ratio i, model, serial number, input/output specs).
Send photos of both ends (input shaft and output shaft/flange) with shaft diameter/keyway and bolt pattern.
Send a short running video (bench run) showing smooth operation; include a sound recording if possible.
Send photos of oil fill/drain area and seals/mating faces to confirm no leaks and correct oil condition.
response.reason: The seller’s statement that it was tested yesterday is not verifiable remotely without a nameplate/spec photo and running proof. With only photo 0, the key factors that determine price and compatibility (exact model/ratio and confirmed working condition) are still missing.
